senses.en: not the same
used to describe several separate people, things, or types

ex.en: Each student has a different style.
ex.zh: 每个学生都有不同风格。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

senses.en: an informal talk

ex.en: They had a long conversation about books.
ex.zh: 他们就书籍进行了长时间交谈。

ex.en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
ex.zh: 经常与语言流利的人交谈有助于语言学习者建立信心并提高听力。

tip: 与某人谈某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

senses.en: something that shows a rule
A person or action that others can learn from or copy

ex.en: Give an example to support your idea.
ex.zh: 举一个例子支持你的观点。

ex.en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。

tip: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

senses.en: to have the same opinion
Decide something together or promise to do something

ex.en: I agree with your suggestion.
ex.zh: 我同意你的建议。

ex.en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的观点
agree on a plan｜就计划达成一致
agree to do something｜答应做某事
agree to a proposal｜同意一项提议
tip: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

senses.en: hard to do
Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.

ex.en: The question is difficult.
ex.zh: 这道题很难。

ex.en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生发现，如果没有所选领域的工作经验，就很难找到稳定的工作。

col: a difficult customer｜难应付的顾客
tip: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。

senses.en: to say what something is like

ex.en: Can you describe the scene in detail?
ex.zh: 你能详细描述那个场景吗？

ex.en: The report describes how access to public parks influences physical activity among residents of crowded cities.
ex.zh: 该报告描述了公共公园的可达性如何影响人口密集城市居民的体育活动。

col: describe something in detail｜详细描述某事物
describe something as｜把某事物形容为
describe a process｜描述一个过程
tip: 说describe something to someone，不说describe someone something。

senses.en: to plan how something looks or works
the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: They will design a new school logo.
ex.zh: 他们将设计一个新的校徽。

ex.en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。

col: be designed to do something｜旨在做某事
tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

senses.en: skill or power to do something

ex.en: Language ability grows with practice.
ex.zh: 语言能力随练习而增长。

ex.en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
ex.zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。

col: the ability to learn｜学习能力
develop an ability｜培养一种能力
tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

senses.en: space between two points
A lack of emotional closeness between people
To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views

ex.en: Keep a safe distance from the fire.
ex.zh: 与火保持安全距离。

ex.en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
ex.zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。

tip: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

senses.en: power to work; power source
Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity

ex.en: Young people have lots of energy.
ex.zh: 年轻人有很多精力。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。

tip: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

senses.en: a contest
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: She won first prize in the competition.
ex.zh: 她在比赛中获得一等奖。

ex.en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
ex.zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。

tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

senses.en: to talk about
to examine a subject in speech or writing

ex.en: Let's discuss the plan after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我们讨论一下计划。

ex.en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
ex.zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。

col: discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事
tip: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

senses.en: to find for the first time

ex.en: Scientists discover new planets every year.
ex.zh: 科学家每年都发现新行星。

ex.en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
ex.zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。

col: discover a new species｜发现新物种
tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: using electricity
Full of excitement and energy.

ex.en: electric cars produce less smoke.
ex.zh: 电动汽车产生更少烟雾。

ex.en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
ex.zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。

tip: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

senses.en: easy to use or reach
Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.

ex.en: Online payment is convenient.
ex.zh: 在线支付很方便。

ex.en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
ex.zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。

col: a convenient way to｜做……的便捷方式
tip: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

senses.en: busy doing things
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: Stay active after school.
ex.zh: 放学后保持活跃。

ex.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。

col: an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式
play an active role｜发挥积极作用
tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: to need support; to be decided by
to need or trust someone or something for support

ex.en: Success may depend on hard work.
ex.zh: 成功可能取决于努力。

ex.en: Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 许多农村社区依靠可靠的公共交通来获得医疗、教育和就业机会。

col: depend on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip: 常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。

senses.en: to grow or improve
to create a new product, method, or idea
to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling

ex.en: Reading helps develop your vocabulary.
ex.zh: 阅读有助于培养词汇量。

ex.en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。

tip: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

senses.en: the way things are not the same
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: Age makes little difference in friendship.
ex.zh: 年龄在友谊中几乎没有差异。

ex.en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
ex.zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。

tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

senses.en: useful
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your notes were very helpful.
ex.zh: 你的笔记很有帮助。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

col: find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

senses.en: an illness

ex.en: Clean water helps prevent disease.
ex.zh: 干净的水有助于预防疾病。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水可以显著减少传染病在脆弱社区中的传播。

col: the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

senses.en: to stop a planned event
To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.

ex.en: They had to cancel the trip because of rain.
ex.zh: 因为下雨他们不得不取消旅行。

ex.en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
ex.zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。

tip: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

senses.en: between countries
A match between countries, or a player representing a country.

ex.en: English is an international language.
ex.zh: 英语是一门国际语言。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。

tip: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

senses.en: the way to go; guidance
instructions explaining how to reach somewhere or do something
the control or guidance of an activity or group

ex.en: Ask for direction if you get lost.
ex.zh: 迷路了就问路。

ex.en: Government investment can influence the direction of technological development by supporting research into cleaner energy sources.
ex.zh: 政府投资可以通过支持清洁能源研究来影响技术发展的方向。

col: in the opposite direction｜朝相反方向
under the direction of｜在……的指导下
tip: 表示路线指引或操作说明时，通常用复数directions。

senses.en: very surprising

ex.en: What an amazing view from the hill!
ex.zh: 山顶的景色多么令人惊奇！

ex.en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
ex.zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。

col: an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

senses.en: to take or agree to something offered
Recognize that something is true or valid
Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation

ex.en: She decided to accept the job offer.
ex.zh: 她决定接受这份工作邀约。

ex.en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
ex.zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。

tip: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

senses.en: simple and most important
Having only necessary features, without anything extra.

ex.en: Learn the basic rules first.
ex.zh: 先学基本规则。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

senses.en: to let someone do something
to make something possible
to provide enough time or resources for something

ex.en: Parents should allow kids to make choices.
ex.zh: 父母应允许孩子做选择。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。

col: allow someone to do something｜允许某人做某事
allow enough time｜留出足够时间
allow for delays｜考虑到可能的延误
tip: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

senses.en: to ruin completely
To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.

ex.en: Fire can destroy a whole forest.
ex.zh: 大火能摧毁整片森林。

ex.en: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
ex.zh: 不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。

tip: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

senses.en: level; a university title
the amount or level of something
a unit used to measure temperature or angles

ex.en: To some degree, luck plays a role.
ex.zh: 在某种程度上，运气起作用。

ex.en: Although a university degree can improve employment prospects, practical experience remains highly valuable in many industries.
ex.zh: 虽然大学学位能改善就业前景，但实践经验在许多行业仍然十分重要。

col: a degree in economics｜经济学学位
to some degree｜在某种程度上
tip: 某专业的学位用a degree in；程度义常见to some degree。

senses.en: the way someone acts
the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions

ex.en: Good behavior is expected in class.
ex.zh: 课堂上期望有良好行为。

ex.en: Schools can encourage responsible behavior by giving students meaningful opportunities to participate in decisions affecting their community.
ex.zh: 学校可以让学生有实质性机会参与影响其社区的决策，以此鼓励负责任的行为。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

senses.en: able to be used or free
Not busy and able to meet or help someone.

ex.en: Is the book available in the library?
ex.zh: 图书馆有这本书吗？

ex.en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
ex.zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。

col: available to everyone｜人人都可获得的
make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

senses.en: taking care to avoid mistakes
giving close attention to details

ex.en: Be careful when you cross the road.
ex.zh: 过马路要小心。

ex.en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
ex.zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。

tip: be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。

senses.en: an opinion about what to do

ex.en: Thank you for your useful advice.
ex.zh: 谢谢你有用的建议。

ex.en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
ex.zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。

col: a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

senses.en: very good

ex.en: She did an excellent job.
ex.zh: 她做得非常出色。

ex.en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。

tip: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

senses.en: a choice made

ex.en: Making a decision can take time.
ex.zh: 做决定可能需要时间。

ex.en: Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.
ex.zh: 政府的每项重大交通决策都应以可靠证据及与受影响社区的协商为基础。

col: informed decision｜基于充分了解的决定
tip: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

senses.en: to become visible; to seem
To seem to be a certain way.
To take part in a performance or attend court formally.

ex.en: A rainbow may appear after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后可能会出现彩虹。

ex.en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。

tip: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: of a particular area
a person who lives in a particular area
affecting only a limited part of something

ex.en: Buy local food when you can.
ex.zh: 尽可能买当地食物。

ex.en: Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
ex.zh: 支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。

tip: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

senses.en: to plan or put in order
Put things in a particular order or position.

ex.en: Please arrange the books on the shelf.
ex.zh: 请把书架上的书整理好。

ex.en: Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
ex.zh: 学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。

col: arrange for someone to do something｜安排某人做某事
tip: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

senses.en: to make something new
to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop

ex.en: Artists create works that move people.
ex.zh: 艺术家创作打动人心的作品。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。

col: create a work of art｜创作艺术作品
tip: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

senses.en: very old
having existed for a very long time

ex.en: We visited an ancient temple.
ex.zh: 我们参观了一座古庙。

ex.en: Studying ancient civilisations helps researchers understand how early societies managed water, trade, and public health.
ex.zh: 研究古代文明有助于研究人员了解早期社会如何管理用水、贸易和公共卫生。

tip: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

senses.en: a quantity
To total something or be equivalent to it.

ex.en: A large amount of rain fell last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚下了大量的雨。

ex.en: Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。

tip: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。

senses.en: of present times
Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.

ex.en: modern technology changes life.
ex.zh: 现代科技改变生活。

ex.en: Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.
ex.zh: 现代技术让偏远地区的学生能够获取过去只有城市才有的教育资源。

tip: modern强调现代或新式；不一定表示刚刚制造。

senses.en: completely correct
Demand and obtain something, often through authority or force.

ex.en: What is the exact time?
ex.zh: 确切时间是几点？

ex.en: Researchers need exact measurements to determine whether changes in air quality are linked to new transport policies.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要精确的测量数据，以判断空气质量变化是否与新的交通政策有关。

col: exact copy｜完全相同的复制品
exact a heavy toll｜造成惨重损失
tip: exact强调分毫不差；副词形式为exactly。

senses.en: to look at differences and similarities
To describe something as similar to another thing.
To be as good as, or similar to, something else.

ex.en: Please compare these two essays carefully.
ex.zh: 请仔细比较这两篇文章。

ex.en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
ex.zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。

col: compare A with B｜将A与B比较
compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B
compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

senses.en: tools needed for a task

ex.en: The lab has modern equipment.
ex.zh: 实验室有现代化设备。

ex.en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
ex.zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。

col: a piece of equipment｜一件设备
tip: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。

senses.en: to disagree in words; to claim
To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.

ex.en: They often argue about small things.
ex.zh: 他们经常为小事争论。

ex.en: Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.
ex.zh: 一些研究者认为，价格可负担的公共交通对于减少大城市中的不平等至关重要。

tip: argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。

senses.en: the natural world around us
The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.

ex.en: We must protect the environment.
ex.zh: 我们必须保护环境。

ex.en: A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.
ex.zh: 支持性的学习环境能够增强学生的信心，鼓励他们更加积极地参与。

tip: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

senses.en: words that tell what something is like

ex.en: Write a short description of your hometown.
ex.zh: 写一段对家乡的简短描述。

ex.en: A clear description of research methods allows other scientists to evaluate the reliability of a study.
ex.zh: 清楚描述研究方法，有助于其他科学家评估研究的可靠性。

col: a job description｜岗位职责说明
tip: 表示对某物的描述，用a description of，不用about。

senses.en: a reason; a movement to support
make something happen, especially something unpleasant
an aim or principle that people support and work towards

ex.en: Pollution is a major cause of illness.
ex.zh: 污染是疾病的一个主要原因。

ex.en: Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 在许多快速发展的城市地区，繁忙的交通是空气污染的主要原因。

tip: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

senses.en: to make a choice
To determine the result of something.

ex.en: We must decide where to go.
ex.zh: 我们必须决定去哪里。

ex.en: Governments must decide how to distribute limited resources between healthcare, education and public transport.
ex.zh: 政府必须决定如何在医疗、教育和公共交通之间分配有限资源。

col: decide to do something｜决定做某事
tip: 用decide to do，不用decide doing。

senses.en: to keep away from
to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: Try to avoid eating too much sugar.
ex.zh: 尽量避免吃太多糖。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，以避免交通拥堵和空气污染进一步加剧。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

senses.en: sure; particular
definitely going to happen
particular but not named or fully described

ex.en: I am certain that she will come.
ex.zh: 我确定她会来。

ex.en: Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.
ex.zh: 某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。

tip: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

senses.en: to join or link
to recognize or establish a relationship between things
to develop a good relationship with someone

ex.en: Roads connect the village to the city.
ex.zh: 公路把村庄与城市连接起来。

ex.en: New rail services can connect rural communities with cities, improving access to education and employment.
ex.zh: 新的铁路服务可以连接农村社区与城市，让人们更容易获得教育和就业机会。

col: connect to the internet｜连接互联网
connect A with B｜把A与B联系起来
connect with people｜与人建立联系
tip: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

senses.en: very big

ex.en: They made a huge effort.
ex.zh: 他们付出了巨大努力。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。

tip: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。

senses.en: an unexpected harmful event
Something that happens without being planned or intended.

ex.en: A car accident blocked the road.
ex.zh: 一起车祸堵住了道路。

ex.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

col: a road accident｜道路交通事故
tip: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

senses.en: an opportunity
The likelihood that something will happen.
Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.

ex.en: This is your chance to speak up.
ex.zh: 这是你发言的机会。

ex.en: Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.
ex.zh: 费用可负担的培训让失业的成年人有机会掌握新技能，重返职场。

col: a chance to learn｜学习的机会
a good chance of｜很有可能
tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

senses.en: knowledge from doing; an event lived through
something that happens to you or that you do
to have something happen to you or feel something

ex.en: Travel is a valuable experience.
ex.zh: 旅行是宝贵的经历。

ex.en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

col: a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历
tip: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

senses.en: to mark a happy event
To praise someone or something publicly.

ex.en: We will celebrate her birthday this weekend.
ex.zh: 我们这个周末会庆祝她的生日。

ex.en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。

col: celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就
tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

senses.en: to surprise greatly

ex.en: The magic trick will amaze the children.
ex.zh: 这个魔术会让孩子们惊奇。

ex.en: Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的进步不断令研究人员惊叹，也为病情复杂的患者带来新的希望。

col: never cease to amaze｜始终令人惊叹
tip: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

senses.en: what is inside
Happy with what you have or with your situation
To make someone satisfied with what is available

ex.en: Check the content of the box carefully.
ex.zh: 仔细检查盒子的内容。

ex.en: Schools should teach students to evaluate online content critically rather than accepting every claim as reliable information.
ex.zh: 学校应教学生批判性地评估网络内容，而不是把每一种说法都当作可靠信息。

col: content yourself with｜使自己满足于
tip: 名词重音在前，形容词和动词在后；目录用contents。

senses.en: to focus attention
To bring things together in one place or direct efforts there.
A substance made stronger by removing water or other material.

ex.en: It is hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂的房间里很难集中注意力。

ex.en: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
ex.zh: 政府应将资源集中于预防性医疗，以长期减轻医院的压力。

col: concentrate on a task｜专注于任务
concentrate resources on｜将资源集中于
tip: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。

senses.en: a way of entering or using
A way of reaching or entering a place.
Reach, enter, or obtain something, especially information on a computer.

ex.en: Students need access to the library.
ex.zh: 学生需要使用图书馆的权限。

ex.en: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会
tip: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。

senses.en: a disagreement; a reason
A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.

ex.en: Their argument lasted for hours.
ex.zh: 他们的争论持续了几个小时。

ex.en: The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

col: a convincing argument｜有说服力的论据
tip: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

senses.en: to become smaller in amount
A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.

ex.en: Pollution may decrease if we use less plastic.
ex.zh: 如果我们少用塑料，污染可能会减少。

ex.en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。

col: a decrease in demand｜需求下降
tip: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

senses.en: a mistake
the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: Check your work for any error.
ex.zh: 检查作业有没有错误。

ex.en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

senses.en: to fasten or join
Consider something to have a particular value or importance

ex.en: Please attach your photo to the form.
ex.zh: 请把照片附在表格上。

ex.en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
ex.zh: 许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。

col: attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上
tip: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

senses.en: to have enough money or time for
to provide something useful or desirable

ex.en: We cannot afford to waste water.
ex.zh: 我们浪费不起水。

ex.en: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
ex.zh: 如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。

col: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事
cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去
tip: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

senses.en: important; large
a main university subject, or a student studying that subject
to study a particular subject as your main university subject

ex.en: Traffic is a major problem.
ex.zh: 交通是一个重大问题。

ex.en: Access to affordable childcare remains a major concern for parents who wish to return to work.
ex.zh: 对于希望重返职场的父母而言，能否获得负担得起的托育服务仍是一个主要顾虑。

tip: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: well known
having knowledge or experience of something

ex.en: This song sounds familiar.
ex.zh: 这首歌听起来很熟悉。

ex.en: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
ex.zh: 熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。

tip: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

senses.en: to be worthy of

ex.en: You deserve a rest after such hard work.
ex.zh: 这么辛苦之后你应得休息。

ex.en: Healthcare workers deserve greater recognition because their dedication contributes directly to the wellbeing of society.
ex.zh: 医护人员值得获得更多认可，因为他们的奉献直接促进了社会福祉。

tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

senses.en: of the mind

senses.zh: 脑力的；在头脑中进行的
senses.en: Using thought rather than physical action or written calculation.

ex.en: mental health matters as much as body health.
ex.zh: 心理健康与身体健康同样重要。

ex.en: Employers should give mental wellbeing the same priority as physical safety when designing workplace policies.
ex.zh: 雇主制定职场政策时，应将心理健康与人身安全放在同等重要的位置。

tip: mental侧重心理或脑力；口语中形容人疯狂可能冒犯。

senses.en: to be good for
to help someone or receive help or an advantage
money provided by the government to people needing support

ex.en: Exercise can benefit both body and mind.
ex.zh: 锻炼有益于身心。

ex.en: Rural communities can benefit from improved internet access through greater opportunities for education and employment.
ex.zh: 更好的互联网接入能增加教育和就业机会，让农村社区受益。

tip: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

senses.en: past experience or setting
Information or events needed to understand a situation
The part of a scene behind the main subject

ex.en: Her family background shaped her views.
ex.zh: 她的家庭背景塑造了她的观点。

ex.en: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

senses.en: straight; clear
To guide or control an activity, performance, or group.
To show the way or aim something towards a place.

ex.en: Take the direct route home.
ex.zh: 走直接回家的路。

ex.en: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。

col: direct attention to｜将注意力转向
tip: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。

senses.en: to make unclear or mixed up
To wrongly think one person or thing is another.

ex.en: Too many choices may confuse buyers.
ex.zh: 选择太多可能让买家困惑。

ex.en: Public health messages can confuse audiences when experts use technical language without explaining its meaning.
ex.zh: 专家使用术语却不解释其含义时，公共卫生信息可能会让受众感到困惑。

col: confuse A with B｜把A与B混淆
confuse the issue｜把问题弄复杂
tip: confused形容人感到困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: wanting to know more
Unusual or strange in a way that attracts attention.

ex.en: Children are curious about nature.
ex.zh: 孩子对自然充满好奇。

ex.en: Teachers can encourage curious students to explore scientific questions through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
ex.zh: 教师可以鼓励求知欲强的学生通过动手实验探索科学问题，而不只是死记硬背。

col: a curious mixture｜奇特的混合物
tip: be curious about表示“对……好奇”。

senses.en: very clever or bright
Exceptionally intelligent or skilled.
Shining brightly or having a strong, vivid colour.

ex.en: She had a brilliant idea.
ex.zh: 她有一个杰出的想法。

ex.en: Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.
ex.zh: 出色的教师能激励学生带着信心和真正的好奇心探索难学的科目。

tip: 英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。

senses.en: happening every day

ex.en: Exercise is part of her daily routine.
ex.zh: 锻炼是她每日例行的一部分。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to say sorry

ex.en: You should apologize for being late.
ex.zh: 你应该为迟到道歉。

ex.en: Companies should apologize promptly for service failures and explain what steps they will take to prevent further problems.
ex.zh: 企业应及时为服务失误道歉，并说明将采取哪些措施来防止问题再次发生。

col: apologize for doing something｜为做某事道歉
tip: 向人道歉用to，为事情道歉用for；英式也写apologise。

senses.en: sure of yourself
certain that something is true or will happen

ex.en: Speak in a confident voice.
ex.zh: 用自信的声音说话。

ex.en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
ex.zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。

col: confident about the future｜对未来有信心
tip: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

senses.en: probable

ex.en: Rain is likely today.
ex.zh: 今天可能下雨。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: hard work
an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal

ex.en: Success needs continuous effort.
ex.zh: 成功需要持续努力。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
ex.zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。

tip: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

senses.en: something accepted as true

ex.en: Strong belief can give people hope.
ex.zh: 坚定的信念能给人希望。

ex.en: The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.
ex.zh: 教育能促进社会流动的这一信念影响着许多国家的政府支出重点。

col: belief in someone｜对某人的信任
a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法
contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

senses.en: to make someone believe

ex.en: She tried to convince him to stay.
ex.zh: 她试图说服他留下来。

ex.en: Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.
ex.zh: 政府必须让居民相信，改善后的公共交通能够切实替代私家车出行。

col: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事
convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

senses.en: to ask for firmly
a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed
to insist on receiving something or require something essential

ex.en: Workers demand better pay and safety.
ex.zh: 工人们要求更好的薪酬和安全。

ex.en: Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.
ex.zh: 对可负担住房不断增长的需求促使地方政府将闲置办公楼改建为住宅。

tip: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

senses.en: to say something is true; to allow in
to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution

ex.en: He had to admit that he was wrong.
ex.zh: 他不得不承认自己错了。

ex.en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
ex.zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。

col: admit doing something｜承认做过某事
be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

senses.en: to make known publicly

ex.en: The teacher will announce the exam date tomorrow.
ex.zh: 老师明天会宣布考试日期。

ex.en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
ex.zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。

tip: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

senses.en: to take air in and out

ex.en: It is hard to breathe in heavy smoke.
ex.zh: 浓烟中很难呼吸。

ex.en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

senses.en: truthful
Expressing what you really think or feel.

ex.en: Be honest about your mistakes.
ex.zh: 对自己的错误要诚实。

ex.en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
ex.zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。

tip: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

senses.en: to harm
Harm something or make it less effective.

ex.en: Floods can damage houses and roads.
ex.zh: 洪水会毁坏房屋和道路。

ex.en: Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.
ex.zh: 不受控制的旅游活动可能破坏脆弱的生态系统，并降低当地居民的生活质量。

col: damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

senses.en: thankful

ex.en: I am grateful for your help.
ex.zh: 我感激你的帮助。

ex.en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
ex.zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。

tip: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

senses.en: short in time or words
To give someone essential information or instructions.
Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.

ex.en: Give a brief summary.
ex.zh: 做个简短总结。

ex.en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
ex.zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。

col: brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况
a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

senses.en: to decide after thinking; to end

ex.en: We can conclude that practice helps.
ex.zh: 我们可以得出结论：练习有帮助。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to have an influence on
to cause someone to feel a strong emotion

ex.en: Noise can affect your ability to sleep.
ex.zh: 噪音会影响你的睡眠能力。

ex.en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。

col: deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人
tip: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

senses.en: something that helps you
A useful or positive feature of something.

ex.en: Speaking two languages is an advantage.
ex.zh: 会说两种语言是一种优势。

ex.en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。

col: have an advantage over｜比……有优势
tip: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

senses.en: to ask for money; to accuse
An amount of money requested for goods or services.
Put electrical energy into a battery or device.

ex.en: Hotels often charge extra for breakfast.
ex.zh: 酒店常对早餐额外收费。

ex.en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
ex.zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。

tip: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

senses.en: a way of thinking or feeling

ex.en: A positive attitude helps in hard times.
ex.zh: 积极态度有助于渡过难关。

ex.en: Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.
ex.zh: 学校可以给予学生建设性的反馈，而非不断批评，以培养积极的学习态度。

tip: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。

senses.en: a result
To bring about a change or result.

ex.en: Sleep has a strong effect on mood.
ex.zh: 睡眠对情绪有强烈影响。

ex.en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。

col: have an effect on｜对……有影响
tip: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

senses.en: to ask formally; to use
To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation
To spread a substance onto a surface

ex.en: She will apply for a scholarship.
ex.zh: 她将申请奖学金。

ex.en: Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
ex.zh: 大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。

col: apply for a job｜申请工作
apply to a university｜向大学提出申请
tip: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

senses.en: happening at once
prepared very quickly, usually by adding hot water
an extremely short period of time

ex.en: She got an instant reply.
ex.zh: 她得到了立即回复。

ex.en: Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.
ex.zh: 数字平台让人们即时获取教育资源，但稳定的网络连接仍然必不可少。

tip: instant作形容词表示即时的；in an instant表示转眼间。

senses.en: a final decision or end
the final part or ending of something

ex.en: The conclusion of the report is clear.
ex.zh: 报告的结论很清楚。

ex.en: Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.
ex.zh: 研究人员根据较小的样本得出结论之前，应考虑其他可能的解释。

tip: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

senses.en: a purpose or goal
to intend or try to achieve something
to point something towards a particular target

ex.en: Our aim is to finish on time.
ex.zh: 我们的目标是按时完成。

ex.en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。

col: aim to do something｜力求做某事
with the aim of｜以……为目的
aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

senses.en: having many parts
A group of buildings used for related activities.

ex.en: The problem is more complex than it looks.
ex.zh: 问题比看上去更复杂。

ex.en: Urban poverty is a complex issue that requires cooperation between governments, businesses and local communities.
ex.zh: 城市贫困是一个复杂问题，需要政府、企业和当地社区共同合作。

tip: 作形容词指复杂；作名词可指综合建筑群。

senses.en: words that make something clear
a reason given for why something happened

ex.en: Her explanation helped us understand.
ex.zh: 她的解释帮助我们理解。

ex.en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。

tip: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

senses.en: whole

ex.en: The entire class passed the test.
ex.zh: 整个班级都通过了考试。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to try to win against others
Take part in a sporting event or other contest.

ex.en: Many teams compete for the prize.
ex.zh: 许多队伍竞争这个奖项。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。

col: compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

senses.en: not needing others' control
not controlled by another person, organisation, or country
not connected with or affected by something else

ex.en: She became more independent at college.
ex.zh: 她上大学后更独立了。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

senses.en: the center of attention
the main subject receiving attention or effort
image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet

ex.en: Keep your focus on the task.
ex.zh: 把注意力集中在任务上。

ex.en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。

tip: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

senses.en: happening often
Visit a particular place regularly

ex.en: frequent rain delayed the flight.
ex.zh: 频繁的降雨延误了航班。

ex.en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
ex.zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。

tip: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: knowing about something

ex.en: Be aware of the risks.
ex.zh: 要意识到风险。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to join together
A farm machine that harvests grain and separates the seeds.

ex.en: Good teachers combine hard work with creativity.
ex.zh: 好老师把努力与创造力结合起来。

ex.en: Cities can combine improved public transport with safer cycling routes to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市可以将公共交通改善与更安全的骑行路线建设相结合，减少对私家车的依赖。

col: combine A with B｜把A与B结合
combine theory and practice｜理论与实践相结合
tip: 动词重音在后；收割机名词读/ˈkɒmbaɪn/。

senses.en: to take in; to hold one's attention

ex.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
ex.zh: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: how someone looks; the act of showing up
an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present

ex.en: First appearance can be misleading.
ex.zh: 第一印象可能具有误导性。

ex.en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。

col: improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

senses.en: the main support or reason
The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.

ex.en: Trust is the basis of friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是友谊的基础。

ex.en: Reliable evidence should provide the basis for government decisions about public health and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。

col: form the basis of｜构成……的基础
tip: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

senses.en: shared customs and arts
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Food is part of local culture.
ex.zh: 食物是当地文化的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: younger or lower in rank
Intended for younger people or involving them
A younger person, or a student below the final year

ex.en: He is a junior member of the team.
ex.zh: 他是队里的初级成员。

ex.en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
ex.zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。

tip: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

senses.en: the usual level or mean
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: His scores are above the average.
ex.zh: 他的分数高于平均水平。

ex.en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
ex.zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: to think about carefully
to have a particular opinion about someone or something
to take someone or something into account

ex.en: Please consider my advice before deciding.
ex.zh: 做决定前请考虑我的建议。

ex.en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
ex.zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。

col: consider all options｜考虑所有选择
be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

senses.en: usual weather of a place
The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.

ex.en: The climate here is warm and wet.
ex.zh: 这里的气候温暖潮湿。

ex.en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
ex.zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。

tip: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

senses.en: bravery

ex.en: It takes courage to speak in public.
ex.zh: 公开演讲需要勇气。

ex.en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。

col: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事
tip: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

senses.en: to protect from attack
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: Soldiers defend the city from danger.
ex.zh: 士兵们保卫城市免受危险。

ex.en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
ex.zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。

col: defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护
tip: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

senses.en: people watching or listening
People who read or receive particular content

ex.en: The audience clapped after the show.
ex.zh: 演出结束后观众鼓掌。

ex.en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
ex.zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。

col: reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众
tip: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

senses.en: to work out a number

ex.en: Can you calculate the total cost?
ex.zh: 你能算出总费用吗？

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: a sudden serious event causing harm
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: An earthquake is a natural disaster.
ex.zh: 地震是一种自然灾害。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: to respect or look up to someone
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire her courage in difficult times.
ex.zh: 我钦佩她在困难时期的勇气。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: a state or requirement
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: The road is in poor condition.
ex.zh: 这条路状况很差。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: allowed by law
Allowed by the law

ex.en: Is this action legal?
ex.zh: 这个行为合法吗？

ex.en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
ex.zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

senses.en: a person with special skill
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: Ask an expert for advice.
ex.zh: 向专家征求建议。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: to invite someone to compete or try hard
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: This puzzle will challenge your mind.
ex.zh: 这道谜题会挑战你的思维。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: a problem
A problem that makes progress or success harder.

ex.en: She overcame great difficulty to succeed.
ex.zh: 她克服巨大困难获得成功。

ex.en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
ex.zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。

col: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难
tip: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

senses.en: to have inside
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This box may contain old letters.
ex.zh: 这个盒子里可能装有旧信。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: to take to a place; to give a speech
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The post office will deliver the package.
ex.zh: 邮局会递送这个包裹。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: something successfully done
The successful completion of a goal through effort.

ex.en: Winning the prize was a great achievement.
ex.zh: 获奖是一项巨大成就。

ex.en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。

col: the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

senses.en: to make sure something is true
To make an arrangement certain or give it official approval.

ex.en: Please confirm your email address.
ex.zh: 请确认你的电子邮箱地址。

ex.en: Further research is needed to confirm whether smaller classes consistently improve learning outcomes in primary schools.
ex.zh: 还需要进一步研究，以证实小学小班教学是否能持续改善学习效果。

tip: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。

senses.en: a formal request; a use
the practical use of knowledge, skills, or methods
a computer program designed to perform particular tasks

ex.en: Send your application before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前递交你的申请。

ex.en: Simplifying the application process could encourage more students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for university scholarships.
ex.zh: 简化申请流程可能鼓励更多来自弱势家庭的学生申请大学奖学金。

tip: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

senses.en: lack of success
a situation in which a machine or organ stops working
not doing something that is expected or required

ex.en: failure can teach useful lessons.
ex.zh: 失败能教会有用的功课。

ex.en: Schools should treat failure as an opportunity for learning rather than as evidence of a student's limited ability.
ex.zh: 学校应将失败视为学习的机会，而不是学生能力有限的证明。

tip: 泛指失败通常不可数；a failure可指失败的事物。

senses.en: to draw interest
Pull something closer through a physical force

ex.en: Bright colors attract many insects.
ex.zh: 鲜艳的颜色吸引许多昆虫。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。

tip: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

senses.en: to annoy or trouble
to make the effort to do something
trouble or effort that causes inconvenience

ex.en: Sorry to bother you so late.
ex.zh: 很抱歉这么晚打扰你。

ex.en: Constant notifications can bother students during lessons and reduce their ability to concentrate on complex tasks.
ex.zh: 持续不断的通知会在课堂上干扰学生，降低他们专注于复杂任务的能力。

col: bother someone with something｜拿某事打扰某人
bother to do something｜费心做某事
a lot of bother｜很多麻烦
tip: bother to do常用于否定或疑问，表示费心做。

senses.en: to be unlike
To have a different opinion from another person.

ex.en: Opinions may differ among friends.
ex.zh: 朋友之间意见可能不同。

ex.en: Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.
ex.zh: 各国的教育重点有所不同，因为经济条件和文化期待会影响国家政策。

col: differ with someone｜与某人意见不同
tip: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。

senses.en: not detailed; overall
describing main points rather than particular details
an officer with a very high rank in the army

ex.en: In general, people prefer weekends.
ex.zh: 一般来说，人们更喜欢周末。

ex.en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
ex.zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

tip: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

senses.en: to say someone is responsible for a fault
Responsibility for something bad that has happened.

ex.en: Don't blame others for your mistakes.
ex.zh: 不要把自己的错误归咎于别人。

ex.en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
ex.zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。

col: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人
blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人
tip: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

senses.en: a member of a country
A person who lives in a particular town or city.

ex.en: Every citizen has rights and duties.
ex.zh: 每个公民都有权利与义务。

ex.en: Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。

col: a responsible citizen｜负责任的公民
tip: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

senses.en: personality; a person in a story
a person represented in a story, play, or film
a written or printed symbol, such as a letter

ex.en: Honesty is part of his character.
ex.zh: 诚实是他性格的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。

tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

senses.en: a number; an important person
a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: The figure on the board is wrong.
ex.zh: 黑板上的数字错了。

ex.en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
ex.zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

senses.en: to succeed in doing something

ex.en: He worked hard to achieve his goals.
ex.zh: 他努力工作以实现目标。

ex.en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。

tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

senses.en: a usual practice
made to meet a particular customer's needs
the business customers give to a shop or company

ex.en: Shaking hands is a common custom.
ex.zh: 握手是一种常见习俗。

ex.en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。

tip: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

senses.en: willing to give
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: She is generous with her time.
ex.zh: 她在时间上很大方。

ex.en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
ex.zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

col: generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

senses.en: the feeling of a place; air around Earth
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: The classroom had a friendly atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教室里气氛友好。

ex.en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
ex.zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。

tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

senses.en: not boastful; not large
not large in size, amount, or cost
wearing clothes that do not reveal much of the body

ex.en: She is modest about her success.
ex.zh: 她对自己的成功很谦虚。

ex.en: Even a modest increase in public transport funding could improve services in rural communities.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通拨款只小幅增加，也可能改善农村社区的服务。

col: modest about one's achievements｜对自己的成就谦虚
tip: 形容人常指谦虚；形容数量常指不大。

senses.en: facts that prove something
To show clearly that something exists or is true.

ex.en: There is no evidence of cheating.
ex.zh: 没有作弊的证据。

ex.en: Governments should consider scientific evidence before introducing policies intended to improve public health outcomes.
ex.zh: 政府在推出旨在改善公共健康状况的政策前，应考虑科学证据。

tip: 作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。

senses.en: a way of dealing with something
To move nearer to someone or something.
To begin dealing with something or contact someone about it.

ex.en: A new approach may solve the problem.
ex.zh: 新方法可能解决这个问题。

ex.en: A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
ex.zh: 均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。

col: an approach to learning｜学习方法
adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
approach a problem｜着手处理问题
approach someone for advice｜找某人征求建议
tip: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

senses.en: about right and wrong
a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story

ex.en: The story has a moral lesson.
ex.zh: 这个故事有道德寓意。

ex.en: Companies have a moral responsibility to ensure that their suppliers provide safe working conditions.
ex.zh: 企业在道义上有责任确保其供应商提供安全的工作环境。

col: the moral of the story｜故事的寓意
tip: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: to carry out; to lead
to allow heat or electricity to pass through
the way a person behaves, especially towards others

ex.en: Scientists conduct experiments in the lab.
ex.zh: 科学家在实验室进行实验。

ex.en: Researchers should conduct thorough trials before recommending new treatments for widespread use in public hospitals.
ex.zh: 研究人员在建议公立医院广泛采用新疗法之前，应开展充分的试验。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

senses.en: to discuss opposing views
To discuss a subject by considering different views.
To think carefully about options before making a decision.

ex.en: Students will debate the topic in class.
ex.zh: 学生们将在课堂上辩论这个话题。

ex.en: The debate over free public transport centres on its environmental benefits and the cost to taxpayers.
ex.zh: 关于免费公共交通的争论集中在其环境效益和纳税人需要承担的费用上。

col: debate an issue｜讨论一个问题
tip: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

senses.en: helpful

ex.en: Walking is beneficial to health.
ex.zh: 散步有益健康。

ex.en: Access to green spaces is particularly beneficial to urban residents who have limited opportunities for outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 对于户外锻炼机会有限的城市居民来说，能够使用绿地尤其有益。

tip: 常接to或for，说明对谁或哪方面有益。

senses.en: a line that marks a limit
A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something

ex.en: Respect personal boundary at work.
ex.zh: 在工作中尊重个人界限。

ex.en: Clear boundaries between work and personal life can protect employees' mental health and reduce long-term stress.
ex.zh: 明确工作与个人生活的界限，可以保护员工的心理健康并减轻长期压力。

tip: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。

senses.en: to try
To try to do something, especially something difficult.

ex.en: She will attempt to climb the mountain.
ex.zh: 她将尝试爬山。

ex.en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
ex.zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。

col: attempt to do something｜尝试做某事
in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

senses.en: worried; eager
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

ex.en: She felt anxious before the test.
ex.zh: 考试前她感到焦虑。

ex.en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
ex.zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。

tip: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

senses.en: to give time or energy to

ex.en: She will devote more time to study.
ex.zh: 她将把更多时间用于学习。

ex.en: Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资源投入预防性医疗，而不是完全依赖昂贵的医学治疗。

tip: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to change to fit a new situation
to change something for a different use or audience

ex.en: Animals must adapt to climate change.
ex.zh: 动物必须适应气候变化。

ex.en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。

col: adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法
adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

senses.en: previous
being the first of two people or things just mentioned

ex.en: He is a former student of this school.
ex.zh: 他是这所学校以前的学生。

ex.en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
ex.zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。

col: former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

senses.en: easy to see or understand

ex.en: It is evident that she studied hard.
ex.zh: 很明显她学习很努力。

ex.en: The benefits of improved public transport are evident in cities where traffic congestion has decreased.
ex.zh: 在交通拥堵有所缓解的城市，改善公共交通的益处显而易见。

tip: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。

senses.en: enough

ex.en: Food supply is adequate.
ex.zh: 食物供应是足够的。

ex.en: Schools need adequate funding to maintain safe buildings and provide effective support for students with additional needs.
ex.zh: 学校需要充足的资金来保障校舍安全，并为有额外需求的学生提供有效支持。

col: adequate for the task｜足以胜任任务
tip: 表示达到所需标准，不等于优秀；常接for或to。

senses.en: real

ex.en: The actual cost was higher.
ex.zh: 实际费用更高。

ex.en: Governments should measure the actual impact of transport policies rather than relying solely on predicted benefits.
ex.zh: 政府应衡量交通政策的实际影响，而不是仅仅依赖预期收益。

tip: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。

senses.en: easy to see; seeming
Seeming to be true, though possibly not actually true.

ex.en: It was apparent that he was tired.
ex.zh: 很明显他累了。

ex.en: Despite the apparent benefits of remote learning, some students struggle without direct support from teachers.
ex.zh: 尽管远程学习看似有诸多好处，一些学生在缺乏教师直接帮助时仍感到吃力。

col: for no apparent reason｜无明显原因
tip: 可指“明显的”，也可指“看似的”，须看语境。

senses.en: happening slowly
Rising or falling gently rather than steeply

ex.en: Progress is often gradual.
ex.zh: 进步往往是逐渐的。

ex.en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
ex.zh: 逐步转向可再生能源有助于社区适应变化，避免就业岗位骤减。

tip: 强调变化缓慢、分阶段；副词形式为gradually。

senses.en: to suppose; to take on
To take on a duty, responsibility, or position.
To begin to have a particular appearance or quality.

ex.en: Don't assume that everyone knows the rules.
ex.zh: 不要假定人人都知道规则。

ex.en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。

tip: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。

senses.en: to take up; to take as one's own
To legally take someone else's child into your family.
To formally approve a proposal, policy, or rule.

ex.en: The school will adopt a new teaching method.
ex.zh: 学校将采用一种新的教学方法。

ex.en: Governments should adopt long-term strategies that improve public transport rather than simply building more roads.
ex.zh: 政府应采取改善公共交通的长期策略，而不是一味增建道路。

col: adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
adopt a policy｜采纳一项政策
tip: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。

senses.en: power to make decisions
an official body responsible for a particular area or service
a person with extensive knowledge of a particular subject

ex.en: The school authority made a new rule.
ex.zh: 学校当局制定了新规则。

ex.en: Local authorities should consult residents before introducing policies that significantly affect access to public services.
ex.zh: 地方当局在推出显著影响公共服务获取的政策前，应征求居民意见。

col: have authority to do something｜有权做某事
an authority on｜某方面的权威
tip: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

senses.en: something given to help
Money or goods given to support a person or cause.
A piece of writing supplied for a publication.

ex.en: His contribution to science was huge.
ex.zh: 他对科学的贡献巨大。

ex.en: Public libraries make a valuable contribution to lifelong learning by providing free access to information.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息资源，为终身学习作出了宝贵贡献。

col: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献
tip: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to value or be thankful for
Recognise and enjoy the value or quality of something.
Understand the importance or difficulty of a situation.

ex.en: I really appreciate your help.
ex.zh: 我真心感激你的帮助。

ex.en: Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.
ex.zh: 政策制定者需要理解农村社区在获取医疗及其他基本服务时面临的困难。

col: appreciate your help｜感谢你的帮助
appreciate the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。

senses.en: correct and exact
able to hit or reach the intended target

ex.en: Give an accurate answer, please.
ex.zh: 请给出准确答案。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。

tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

senses.en: the right to act freely
The state of not experiencing something unpleasant.

ex.en: Speech freedom is valued in many places.
ex.zh: 许多地方重视言论自由。

ex.en: Universities should protect academic freedom while encouraging researchers to consider the social consequences of their work.
ex.zh: 大学应保护学术自由，同时鼓励研究人员考虑其工作的社会影响。

tip: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。

senses.en: basic and important
A basic principle or skill, usually considered with others.

ex.en: Honesty is a fundamental value.
ex.zh: 诚实是基本价值观。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental requirement for improving public health in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水是改善弱势社区公共卫生的基本条件。

tip: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。

senses.en: a matter or event
a romantic relationship involving someone committed to another partner

ex.en: Public affair need careful attention.
ex.zh: 公共事务需要认真关注。

ex.en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。

tip: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

senses.en: first
The first letter of a person's name
To mark a document with the first letters of your names

ex.en: My initial plan was wrong.
ex.zh: 我最初的计划是错的。

ex.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
ex.zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

senses.en: to state officially
to officially report goods, income or other required information

ex.en: The mayor will declare the festival open.
ex.zh: 市长将宣布节日开幕。

ex.en: Local authorities may declare a public holiday to encourage participation in an important community celebration.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能宣布放假一天，以鼓励民众参加重要的社区庆典。

col: declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态
tip: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

senses.en: facts and figures

ex.en: Scientists collect data from tests.
ex.zh: 科学家从实验中收集数据。

ex.en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。

tip: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

senses.en: a condition around an event
the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation

ex.en: Under no circumstance should you lie.
ex.zh: 在任何情况下你都不该说谎。

ex.en: Schools should consider each student's personal circumstances when developing policies on attendance and access to learning resources.
ex.zh: 学校制定出勤和学习资源获取政策时，应考虑每位学生的个人情况。

col: under the circumstances｜在这种情况下
tip: 常用复数；under no circumstances置句首须倒装。

senses.en: fine; easily broken
Requiring careful handling to avoid problems or offence.
Fine, subtle, or gentle in appearance, flavour, or smell.

ex.en: Handle the glass with delicate care.
ex.zh: 轻拿轻放这些玻璃。

ex.en: Tourism in coastal regions must be carefully managed to protect delicate ecosystems from lasting damage.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的旅游业必须得到妥善管理，以保护脆弱的生态系统免遭长期破坏。

col: delicate negotiations｜需谨慎进行的谈判
tip: 既可形容易损物品，也可形容需谨慎处理的问题。

senses.en: to tell apart
to make someone or something different from others
to see or hear something clearly enough to recognize it

ex.en: Babies learn to distinguish colors early.
ex.zh: 婴儿很早就能学会辨别颜色。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish reliable evidence from personal opinion when evaluating information online.
ex.zh: 学生在评估网络信息时，应学会区分可靠证据与个人观点。

col: distinguish A from B｜把A与B区分开
tip: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。

senses.en: able to change easily
able to bend easily without breaking

ex.en: Keep a flexible schedule.
ex.zh: 保持灵活的时间安排。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。

col: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间
tip: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

senses.en: a feeling of worry

ex.en: Exam anxiety is common among students.
ex.zh: 考试焦虑在学生中很常见。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。

tip: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

senses.en: a serious disagreement
A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree.
To disagree with or be incompatible with something.

ex.en: Talking can reduce family conflict.
ex.zh: 沟通可以减少家庭冲突。

ex.en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 当工业高度依赖化石燃料时，经济增长可能与环境保护相冲突。

col: a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: to send out by radio or TV
A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.

ex.en: The match will broadcast live tonight.
ex.zh: 比赛今晚将直播。

ex.en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
ex.zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

senses.en: the purpose of something
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: What is the function of this button?
ex.zh: 这个按钮的功能是什么？

ex.en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
ex.zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。

tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

senses.en: a worry or interest

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项
senses.en: An issue that matters or causes worry
To relate to someone or something, or cause worry

ex.en: Health is a shared concern for all.
ex.zh: 健康是所有人共同的关切。

ex.en: Growing concern about air pollution has encouraged many cities to invest in cleaner public transport systems.
ex.zh: 人们对空气污染日益担忧，促使许多城市投资建设更清洁的公共交通系统。

col: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧
a major concern｜一个主要问题
concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

senses.en: the state of being away
a situation in which something does not exist or occur

ex.en: His absence from class worried the teacher.
ex.zh: 他缺课让老师担心。

ex.en: In the absence of reliable public transport, many residents have little choice but to drive.
ex.zh: 在缺乏可靠公共交通的情况下，许多居民别无选择，只能开车。

col: in someone's absence｜在某人不在时
in the absence of｜在缺乏……的情况下
tip: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

senses.en: happening all the time
remaining the same over time
a value or quantity that does not change

ex.en: There is constant noise from the street.
ex.zh: 街上有持续的噪音。

ex.en: Maintaining a constant temperature in public buildings can improve comfort but may increase energy consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑保持恒温可以提高舒适度，但可能增加能源消耗。

tip: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

senses.en: made by people, not natural
Not sincere or natural in appearance or behaviour

ex.en: artificial light can hurt sleep.
ex.zh: 人造光可能影响睡眠。

ex.en: Excessive artificial lighting in urban areas can disrupt wildlife behaviour and reduce the visibility of stars.
ex.zh: 城市中过量的人工照明会扰乱野生动物的行为，并使星星难以看清。

tip: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

senses.en: to give out
to spread something over an area

ex.en: Volunteers distribute food to the poor.
ex.zh: 志愿者向穷人分发食物。

ex.en: Governments must distribute healthcare resources fairly so that rural communities receive the same quality of care as urban residents.
ex.zh: 政府必须公平分配医疗资源，让农村社区享有与城市居民同等质量的医疗服务。

tip: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。

senses.en: to give for a purpose
To help cause a particular result
To write material for a publication or website

ex.en: Everyone can contribute to the project.
ex.zh: 每个人都能为这个项目做贡献。

ex.en: Limited access to affordable housing can contribute to social inequality and force workers to accept longer commutes.
ex.zh: 难以获得可负担住房可能加剧社会不平等，并迫使劳动者接受更长的通勤时间。

col: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论
contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长
tip: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: total; complete
not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities

ex.en: He has absolute confidence in the team.
ex.zh: 他对团队有绝对信心。

ex.en: Giving any single institution absolute power can weaken accountability and reduce public trust in government.
ex.zh: 赋予任何单一机构不受限制的权力，都可能削弱问责机制并降低公众对政府的信任。

col: an absolute necessity｜绝对必需的事物
tip: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

senses.en: to decide firmly; to find out
To control or strongly influence what happens.
To make a firm decision to do something.

ex.en: Tests help determine your progress.
ex.zh: 测试有助于测定你的进步。

ex.en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.
ex.zh: 在政府投入大量资金增聘教师之前，研究人员必须确定小班教学是否能改善学习成果。

tip: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。

senses.en: not guilty; pure
Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life.
Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.

ex.en: The child looked innocent.
ex.zh: 孩子看上去很天真。

ex.en: A fair legal system must protect innocent people while ensuring that those responsible for crimes face justice.
ex.zh: 公平的法律制度必须保护无辜者，同时确保犯罪者受到法律制裁。

col: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪
tip: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

senses.en: suitable
to take something for your own use without permission
to officially set aside money for a particular purpose

ex.en: Wear appropriate clothes for the interview.
ex.zh: 面试穿合适的衣服。

ex.en: Governments should provide appropriate training to help workers adapt to technological changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 政府应提供适当培训，帮助劳动者适应劳动力市场中的技术变革。

tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词读/eɪt/。

senses.en: ease of use
Something that makes daily life easier.

ex.en: Online shopping offers great convenience.
ex.zh: 网购提供极大便利。

ex.en: Although online shopping offers convenience, it may encourage unnecessary spending and increase packaging waste.
ex.zh: 虽然网上购物带来了便利，但它可能助长不必要的消费，并增加包装垃圾。

tip: 表示“方便”通常不可数；形容词是convenient。

senses.en: a result of an action
The quality of being important or worth considering.

ex.en: Every choice has a consequence.
ex.zh: 每个选择都有后果。

ex.en: One serious consequence of rapid urban growth is increased pressure on public transport and housing.
ex.zh: 城市快速扩张的一个严重后果是公共交通和住房承受的压力增大。

tip: as a consequence of后接原因，意为“由于”。

senses.en: to leave or give up
To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished.
A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.

ex.en: We had to abandon the plan after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后我们不得不放弃那个计划。

ex.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
ex.zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。

tip: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。
